title: WalletRadar sidecar attributes
description: Sourced, unscored attributes kept outside the scored markdown tables. Omit an entry (or use value 'unknown') when no primary source was read. Never affects Score/Rec.

section.description: Keyed by the row name in the first cell of the root markdown table (text inside [**Name**]).

evidence_url.description: Optional primary page (e.g. the bounty program) that the pinned source_url data points to.

x-attributes.label: Bug bounty
x-attributes.source_rule: WalletBeat data pinned at commit 82e3036aba53d8dd13a55f42089ba09c44afa8c5 (MIT), or the wallet's official security/bounty page. 'none' = WalletBeat records no program; WalletBeat null (not evaluated) is left out.

x-attributes.label: Reproducible build
x-attributes.source_rule: WalletScrutiny verdict string only (store verdict + link, no review text; per-review licence caveat). Verdict of the Android/primary build, read from the review markdown.

x-attributes.label: Chain verification (L1 light client)
x-attributes.source_rule: WalletBeat lightClient.ethereumL1 only. 'none' = notSupported; null (not evaluated) is left out.

x-attributes.label: KYC requirement
x-attributes.source_rule: Issuer page that states identity verification/KYC for the card. No entry when only generic security wording is available.

x-attributes.label: Card network
x-attributes.source_rule: Issuer page naming the network of the card (issuer legal text or product page). Secondary articles and snippets are not sources.
